name: King's Squire
passiveDesc: Obtain the Teachings of the Forest effect when unleashing Elemental Skills and Bursts, increasing Elemental Mastery by 60/80/100/120/140 for 12s. This effect will be removed when switching characters. When the Teachings of the Forest effect ends or is removed, it will deal 100%/120%/140%/160%/180% of ATK as DMG to 1 nearby opponent. The Teachings of the Forest effect can be triggered once every 20s.

modifiers.label: Teachings of the Forest: Elemental Mastery while active

skills.label: Teachings of the Forest: damage when the effect ends or is removed
